question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The thief was caught with a __spurious__ Picasso painting.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Authentic.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Spurious" means fake or false.**

 
 
• ​Example: The document seems spurious to me.
 
 
 
• **​"Authentic" means genuine or real.**
 
 
• ​Example: Those evidences were authentic.
 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the Picasso painting was not a real one, but a fake one that the thief was caught with.
 
• Therefore, the opposite or antonym of "spurious" would be "authentic," which means that the painting is a genuine Picasso.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Fake"** is a synonym of "spurious," not an antonym.
 
• Option 2: **"Stolen"** means taking things from someone, especially secretly.
 
• Option 3: **"Splendid"** means something very good or excellent.
